contract.title: Wave A: ranking-policy-qualification.ts registry parser and key helpers
contract.invariant: Registry parser enforces unique logical tuple keys (artifactSha256, serviceClass, qualificationScopeKey) and canonical lexicographic ordering by UTF-8 bytes of the tuple; canonical empty genesis snapshot is exact; canonical round-trip.
production_callers: (no base runtime caller; Wave F consumers per §7.2: F2 qualification store, F9 qualification writer; A11Q receipts parsers)
interface_changes: packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-policy-qualification.ts (new file; RankingPolicyQualificationRegistryV1 parser + QualificationEntryKeyV1/qualificationScopeKey helpers per §5.4; qualificationScopeKey = sha256(canonicalJSON({serviceClass, qualificationTargetSha256, selectedArtifactMode, qualifiedRerankers})))
security_boundaries: Duplicate logical keys rejected; entries sorted lexicographically by UTF-8 bytes of the tuple; exact genesis snapshot {"schemaVersion":"ranking_policy_qualification_registry_v1","entries":[]}; disabled mode has empty qualifiedRerankers, provider_derived exactly one matching FixedProviderTargetV1 (§5.4)
overlap_with: FT-A2: A11Q requires A6; A11H requires A11Q (transitively A6)
F2 and F9 (Wave F): require A6
R1.4: activation contract index is a sealed authority input
contract.instructions: Create packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-policy-qualification.ts (new file) with the registry parser and key helpers per §5.4: RankingPolicyQualificationRegistryV1, QualificationEntryKeyV1 (artifactSha256, serviceClass, qualificationScopeKey), qualificationScopeKey = sha256(canonicalJSON({serviceClass, qualificationTargetSha256, selectedArtifactMode, qualifiedRerankers})). §7.6 A6 RED row: test 'rejects_duplicate_logical_entry_keys_and_noncanonical_order'; expected failure: duplicate or unsorted entries are accepted; minimal passing: parser enforces unique tuple keys and canonical ordering. Canonical empty genesis snapshot is exact. Entries sorted lexicographically by the UTF-8 bytes of the logical tuple. State transitions (pending_heldout -> activation_qualified, pending_heldout -> revoked, activation_qualified -> revoked) replace exactly one logical key — never append a second state for the same key. Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A6 row) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-mcp test is repo-verified and must pass.
